acceptance_checks: .shiki/guardian-policy.json defines Guardian users, teams, approval sources, required label, current-head comment requirement, solo-maintainer policy, and explicit CCA Review Bridge / advisory Claude exclusions.
scripts/shiki_guardian.py loads, validates, and evaluates Guardian policy using only Python standard library APIs.

MergeGate requires policy-backed Guardian approval for high-risk and critical PRs and blocks label-only, github-actions Review Bridge, advisory Claude review, wrong-head comments, unconfigured actors, missing policy, and missing live evidence.
.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml fetches live Guardian comments, issue events, and timeline evidence before running MergeGate policy check.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates Guardian policy, manifest/install coverage, workflow evidence wiring, docs, and template staging.
scripts/shiki_doctor.py reports Guardian policy, approvers, solo-maintainer policy, and online issue comments/events API diagnostics.
scripts/test_shiki_guardian_policy.sh covers policy validation, approval evaluation, MergeGate evidence requirements, workflow wiring, and doctor findings.

Docs describe Guardian policy, approvers, label/comment/review sources, current head SHA requirement, solo-maintainer mode, and why CCA Review Bridge / advisory Claude review are not Guardian approval.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.4.3 CCA verdict evidence hardening.
Do not implement P1.4.4 ledger hash-chain, signature, or GitHub check/artifact cross-reference.
Do not implement P1.4.5 mirror/generated/cache/local-only state classification.
Do not implement P1.4.6 forged/stale/missing governance evidence suite.
Do not implement P2 documentation, packaging, release, or onboarding work.
Do not add a new GitHub App or reviewer bot.
Do not change CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection or CODEOWNERS ownership rules.
Do not change P0.4 evidence, lock, ID, or ledger semantics.
Do not change runtime adapter execution behavior.
Do not change Node workflow runtime policy.
scope: Define machine-readable Guardian approvers and approval policy, then enforce it for high-risk and critical PRs through MergeGate, validator, doctor, workflow evidence fetches, tests, docs, manifest, and migration state.
title: Define Guardian approvers and approval policy
